selected_station_sensor: Onset S-WCF-M003, modified Davis anemometer for HOBO stations

notes: Source explicitly says modified for Onset loggers only; do not apply the ordinary Davis RJ11 wiring.
Diagram specifies a D-shaped vane shaft, separate cup assembly, one U-bolt and an arm through-screw with separate washer and nut.
Page 1 photograph was inspected at embedded resolution: cream ribbed cylindrical inline adapter with hexagonal end caps; dimensions are not supplied.
Page 2 kit includes two 1/4 x 3 inch optional lag screws and one 0.05 inch Allen wrench. Tool leg lengths and lag-head dimensions are not supplied.

sources.role: Related original mechanical design; not the selected Onset electrical variant
notes: Davis specifies RJ11, four-conductor 26 AWG cable and 40 ft / 12 m. These facts must not replace the Onset variant.
Listed dimensions are 381 x 38 x 457 mm; an assembled-state datum is not shown.
The same sheet states 1 lb 4 oz and 1.332 kg, which are not equivalent; its package weight is 2 lb / 0.9 kg. Preserve the conflict rather than assign an authoritative inertia.
Related assembly diagrams support the distinct vane, cup rotor, arm and base topology. Do not copy its cable length to the Onset variant.
Black bent tubular arm, hourglass lower housing, three open cups, swept vane fin and brass nose. Perspective photograph is not a dimensioned drawing.
Separate ribbed mast base with long mounting slots; separate cup and vane pieces and a hardware bag. Source image is retained locally, not redistributed.

Official product-page image confirms short radial ribs relative to each 38.1 mm cup. The primary 60 mm sweep-radius hypothesis follows those proportions; it is not a calibrated photogrammetric measurement.
A 108 mm literal-radius rotor is retained as separate alternative geometry. No claim that the manufacturer confirmed an error or that 108 mm actually means a diameter.
Manufacturer describes replacement cups for Vantage Pro2 anemometers from spring 2003 onward. This is a mechanical reconstruction reference; exact Onset replacement SKU is not established.

unresolved_conflicts: Onset page 1/product specifies 3 m cable; page 2 labels a 40 ft / 12.2 m arm. The latter matches the related Davis original, but a copied-diagram explanation is an inference.
Onset calls 108 mm a cup turning radius while listing a 191 mm static width. The full 216 mm sweep cannot be assumed to fit that width.

The Onset and Davis photographs, including the official 7905L single-rotor image, show shorter ribs than the literal 108 mm radius yields. Primary geometry selects a labeled 60 mm radius hypothesis; the literal 108 mm alternative remains inspectable. Perspective, source revision and dimensional meaning remain unresolved.
Published overall dimensions lack component datums; local arm shape, base size, shaft diameters, bearing geometry and wall thicknesses remain inferences.
cad_result: No exact reusable manufacturer CAD obtained in these searches. Unrelated printable anemometers were not substituted.
rights: Original generated geometry only. Manufacturer photographs and PDFs remain external/local references; no redistribution permission established.
